changed_sections.section: Interval reference, callback and pending snapshot lifetime
changed_sections.disposition: No FPGA record layout change. Existing modulo-16384 count steps, sequence, loss flag, first-word timestamp and delta correction retained.
Reference watchdog changed to 3 ms on the independent bus clock. Feedback remains published until the expiry edge. A coincident reference is refused and cannot seed the replacement window.
No changed FPGA duty; all 22 network-attachment files remain unchanged.
Firmware tests added; FPGA tests independently cover the new watchdog bounds.

boundary_scope: Own-clock watchdog tested independently of the unchanged source-clock delivery bounds; media timestamps remain continuous for replacement tests and stop advancing for no-reference expiry.
